messages:
elaine-sales: Heads up — LedgerOps POC is seeing intermittent 5xx (mostly 503) during today's demo. Errors spike when they hit ~300 rps, tail latencies jump and requests drop. Can we swarm? They’re nervous and the demo is live.

raj-eng: On it. Are they hitting Hosted API or Dedicated pool? Any request_ids or sample logs?

alice-support: Customer attached a log snippet, copied below. They’re on Hosted; region us-west-2.
```
[2026-03-21T15:02:12Z] request_id=abc123 model=redwood-xl tokens=512 status=503 error="overloaded: no available workers" backend=swarm-01
[2026-03-21T15:02:12Z] request_id=abc124 model=redwood-xl tokens=16 status=200 latency_ms=95
[2026-03-21T15:02:13Z] request_id=abc125 model=redwood-xl tokens=1024 status=503 error="queue timeout" backlog=420
```

tim-sre: Looks like backlog + burstpool exhaustion. Can someone confirm autoscale policy and burstpool quota for this account? Might be autoscaler lagging behind spike.

raj-eng: Checking policy now. Their account config: `autoscale: min=0 max=8 scale_step=2 cooldown=60s` and `burstpool: size=4`. With 300rps and long seq lengths (~800-1200 tokens) that could saturate quickly.

chris-ml: We can also offer a quantized variant (rdx-xl-q4) that uses ~40% less memory — less workers per GPU. If we enable fallback to that model when capacity low it should reduce 503s.

maria-oncall: I'm going to temporarily add +2 GPUs to the hosted burst pool for this tenant and enable the model-fallback route for their API key. ETA ~6m. I'll also bump the burstpool size to 6 while we monitor.

elaine-sales: Thanks Maria — I told the customer to pause non-demo batch loads and throttle to ~150 rps for the next 10m. They agreed. :pray:

tim-sre: Quick checks you can run: `curl -s https://ops.internal/metrics?service=swarm-01&from=now-10m` — look at `inflight_requests`, `queue_length`, `worker_count`. If queue_length > 300 that aligns with the logs.

ops-bot: Deploy queued: enable-fallback-policy for tenant ledgerops by deploy-bot.

raj-eng: Also seeing elevated `token-seq` distribution in traces — many long-seq requests are pushing memory. We should recommend request caps or per-request token limits in POC.

maria-oncall: Scaling performed: +2 GPUs attached to pool (swarm-01). Burstpool now 6. Fallback policy enabled pointing ledgerops key -> rdx-xl-q4.

deploy-bot: Rollout complete: fallback-policy v1 applied to tenant ledgerops.

alice-support: I just confirmed with the customer: errors dropped, demo resumed. They still want guidance on POC sizing and an enterprise quote for Dedicated.

chris-ml: I'll prepare a short note comparing throughput/cost: rdx-xl (fp16) vs rdx-xl-q4 (quant) across sequence lengths and a recommended Dedicated pool size for sustained 300rps with 95th pct latency < 200ms.

elaine-sales: Perfect. Action items: Maria follow up with post-mortem + monitoring dashboard link; Chris send model/cost note; Raj to propose autoscale/burstpool defaults for POC docs; I'll update the SOW for Dedicated sizing.

maria-oncall: Will drop a short incident summary and metrics (5m window) in this thread in ~30m. Monitoring watch for 20m.

elaine-sales: Thanks team — saved the demo. I'll loop in the LedgerOps engineering lead for a short post-demo sync. :thumbsup:
